# Apache HTTPD (HTTP) — load-balancer-sse

Two backends balanced by mod_proxy_balancer with sticky sessions via a synthesized ROUTEID cookie, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. Affinity has to hold for the EventSource GET and for the separate client-to-server XHR POSTs.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Apache HTTPD config (`vaadin.conf`):

```apache
# SSE-only load balancer. Sticky sessions matter more here than with
# WebSocket: SSE is two separate connections — the EventSource GET that streams
# down, and the XHR POSTs that go up — so both must land on the backend that
# owns the session, not just the one long-lived socket.
#
# Requires mod_proxy_balancer, mod_lbmethod_byrequests and mod_slotmem_shm
# to be loaded.
<Proxy "balancer://application-balancer/">
    BalancerMember "http://vaadin-1:8080" route=1
    BalancerMember "http://vaadin-2:8080" route=2
    ProxySet stickysession=ROUTEID
    ProxySet lbmethod=byrequests
</Proxy>

<Location / >
    # Adding a cookie for session affinity instead of backend JSESSIONID because:
    # - additional configuration required on the backend server to add the route id
    #   in the cookie value (e.g. jvmRoute for tomcat)
    # - The backend cookie might not be set on the very first request
    Header add Set-Cookie "ROUTEID=.%{BALANCER_WORKER_ROUTE}e; path=/; HttpOnly" env=BALANCER_ROUTE_CHANGED

    ProxyPass         "balancer://application-balancer/"
    ProxyPassReverse  "balancer://application-balancer/"
</Location>
```
